{{SectionBreak}} '''Neow''' is an NPC in Slay the Spire. She is a large, whale-like creature with light blue skin and six bright yellow eyes. Neow lies at the foot of The Spire and welcomes the player to every run. Neow blesses adventurers with rewards based on their previous success, offering [[gold]], [[relics]], or [[cards]], unless they failed to reach the [[Bosses|Boss]] of the [[Act 1|Exordium]], in which case she offers only two options instead of the usual four, and one of them is the aptly named relic {{R|Neow's Lament}}. It weakens the monsters in the first few encounters in the Spire to 1 HP, sometimes even giving the adventurer a free shot at an [[Elites|elite]] monster. ==Blessings== If you failed to reach the [[Bosses|Boss]] of the [[Act 1|Exordium]] in your last run, the Blessings you can have are: * Max HP +8/6/7/7 ([[Ironclad]]/[[Silent]]/[[Defect]]/[[Watcher]]) * {{R|Neow's Lament|Enemies in the next three combat will have one health.}} If you reached the [[Bosses|Boss]] of the [[Act 1|Exordium]], Neow will offer you four Blessings, and you can choose one of them. The first Blessing will be a card-related reward from the following list: * Remove a card. * {{KW|Transform}} a card. * Upgrade a card. * Choose a card to obtain. (Choose one of 3 random cards from your Class) *Choose an uncommon [[Colorless Cards|colorless card]] to obtain. * Obtain a random rare card. The second Blessing will be a reward that isn't directly related to your cards, chosen from the options below: * Max HP +8/6/7/7 ([[Ironclad]]/[[Silent]]/[[Defect]]/[[Watcher]]) * {{R|Neow's Lament|Enemies in the next three combat will have one health.}} * Obtain a random common relic. * Receive 100 gold. * Obtain 3 random [[potions]]. The third Blessing is a composite of one disadvantage and a better reward. It can be a combination of any disadvantages and rewards below, with exceptions noted: * Disadvantages: ** {{Color|tomato|Lose max health}} *** 8/7/7/7 ([[Ironclad]]/[[Silent]]/[[Defect]]/[[Watcher]]) ** {{Color|tomato|Take damage}} *** Damage is equal to {{Color|skyBlue|(Current HP / 10, rounded down) * 3}} **** The amount of damage is not static. It is affected by [[Ascension]] 6 (lose 10% of HP at the start of the run) and [[Ascension]] 14 (reduced max HP). ** {{Color|tomato|Obtain a}} {{KW|Curse|Curse}} ** {{Color|tomato|Lose all gold}} * Rewards: **{{Color|LawnGreen|Remove 2 cards.}} (Does not pair with {{Color|tomato|Obtain a}} {{KW|Curse|Curse}}) ** {{KW|Transform}} {{Color|LawnGreen|2 cards.}} ** {{Color|LawnGreen|Gain 250 gold.}} (Does not pair with {{Color|tomato|Lose all gold}}) ** {{Color|LawnGreen|Choose a rare card to obtain.}} **{{Color|LawnGreen|Choose a rare}} [[Colorless Cards|colorless card]] {{Color|LawnGreen|to obtain.}} ** {{Color|LawnGreen|Obtain a random rare relic.}} ** {{Color|LawnGreen|Max HP +16/12/14/14}} ([[Ironclad]]/[[Silent]]/[[Defect]]/[[Watcher]]) (Does not pair with {{Color|tomato|losing max health}}) The last Blessing offered will always be: * Replace your [[Relics#Starter|starter relic]] with a random [[Boss Relic]]. ==Trivia== * Little is known about Neow as she is not very talkative herself. However her actions suggest that she begrudges the Spire and wants to destroy it, and does so by sending resurrected adventurers up the Spire. *Neow is depicted as possessing powerful magical abilities, which go as far as resurrecting the dead, which she shows whenever an adventurer dies atop the Spire, so they can continue their duty. *The [[Cursed Tome]] event gives more insight on Neow's origins. *The [[Sensory Stone]] event references the [[Defect|Defect's]] first interaction with Neow. *After defeating the [[Corrupt Heart]], an extra screen plays after the credits, depicting Neow saying "Has ... it ... been ... done?/The Spire sleeps ... and so shall I" *Her name may be an onomatopoeia of a whale song. ==Update History== *Patch V2.0: The Watcher **Neow Colorless card choices now let the player choose 1 of 3 colorless cards. *Slay the Spire 1.0: Farewell Early Access **The post-credits Neow cutscene can now be sped up if you click 5 times during the cutscene. *Weekly Patch 53: Blizzard **Crash fix when looking at Deck, Map, or Settings after getting Pandora's Box at Neow. *Weekly Patch 47: Metamorphosis **Standard Runs with set seeds now always give you Neow's Blessing. **Fixed issue where Neow did not give anything to players who first encountered her. *Weekly Patch 46: Adrenaline **We created Neow with the intent to foster creative deckbuilding.
